title: bridges
content: has anyone ever been to a bridge? I remember leaving a coffee shop and turning the corner and all of a sudden I was at a very large pier with a bunch of bridges attached. They were only letting certain people through, everyone was rushing and there were officers at each bridge entrance checking people as they crossed. I somehow snuck past but they noticed me about halfway across and started to chase me. I made it across and on the other end of the bridge was another pier that led into a large store. I walked through the store and then suddenly I was inside my regularly visited mall world. This is the last thing I remember before waking up.
